landing.title: Ishara — Two-Way Sign Language Translator
landing.heroHeading: Breaking Silence with Intelligent Gesture Translation
landing.heroSub: Seamless two-way translation between Indian Sign Language (ISL) / American Sign Language (ASL) and spoken voice across 10 Indian languages. Powered by on-device AI.
landing.statLanguagesDesc: English, Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi

landing.statOfflineDesc: Runs anywhere without an internet connection
landing.featureSignToVoiceDesc: Computer vision translates camera gestures into clear spoken natural speech.

landing.featureEmergencyDesc: One-tap high-decibel siren, screen beacon, and offline emergency help cards.
landing.featureLearnDesc: Structured daily sign lessons, gesture practice, and knowledge quizzes.
landing.step1Desc: Use your webcam for signs or tap microphone to speak in your native language.
landing.step2Desc: MediaPipe landmark tracking & on-device grammar parsing convert tokens instantly.
landing.step3Desc: Hear spoken translation aloud or watch avatar animations.
landing.footerCopy: Ishara — Developed for accessibility and inclusive communication.

landing.cardVoiceOutputSub: भावनात्मक पिच और गति मॉड्यूलेशन के साथ स्पष्ट आवाज़ संश्लेषण।

landing.privacyFeat2Desc: साइन इन करने पर ही इतिहास सुरक्षित RLS के साथ संग्रहीत होता है।
